verdict_reason: The widening logic fixes the ordinary oversized-record defect and the scheduled task's explicit exception policy does not falsely print VERIFIED. Release remains blocked because process attribution is still forgeable through arbitrary command-line occurrence of the resolved path and regex pseudo-tokens, and because an unreadable snapshot can be assigned boundary zero and later confuse same-name replacement with continuation. Each route can produce exit 0 while the claimed subject was not actually verified.
